programs.title: Ancient Egypt By Train
programs.desc: Professor Alice Roberts goes on a long journey to get to know Egypt better.Following the paths from the book he learned in childhood, "A Thousand Leagues on the Waves of the Nile", he goes from Cairo to the Great Pyramids.

programs.title: Life Below Zero: Canada
programs.desc: The creators of the series present the everyday life of a group of daredevils struggling with wildlife in various regions of northern Canada during a frosty winter.Johnatan Granier will join the program in the second season.

programs.title: Where the Wild Men Are UK
programs.desc: Traveler Ben Fogle travels around the British Isles in search of people who gave up living in big cities and moved to the provinces to be closer to nature.

programs.title: Blue Planet 2: The Making of
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of the creation of a spectacular nature series that took 4 years to film.The teams implementing it visited all oceans.Thanks to the fact that the divers had the latest equipment, they could have very close encounters with the animals being filmed.Even in low light conditions, the cameras captured events invisible to the human eye.Inspection cameras show the lives of small creatures, and those equipped with a suction cup record what is happening in the ocean from the perspective of larger animals.Wanting to film the most extraordinary wildlife scenes, the team also visited coastlines in the farthest corners of the world, such as the Galapagos Islands.Marine life around these islands depends on cold currents feeding surface waters.
